featured_reviews.name: Valentine Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had our Catholic Staff Association annual get together at M. G. Banquets hall on 7th December 2025. This venue (formerly known to older residents of Bandra as .. Kalyan Kendra), is ideally located just a furlong away from St. Peter's Church on Hill Road, which is an ideal and prime location. This hall, I have been informed, can host upto 300 persons for any function.
I must say that the experience was absolutely fantastic and memorable. Racquel & Joshua were absolutely cooperative and receptive to suggestions and helpful in all matters pertaining to the logistics and set up of the totally air conditioned hall. The entire hall with me it's welcoming bright, colourful ambience, its linen covered tables & chairs with a choice of ribbon bow tie colours, dinner tables, inhouse decorations, stage, bar (if required), and a lot of other amenities, were offered at a very reasonable package deal, and the facility of extended music timings was an absolute bonus. M. G Banquets has a panel of decorators, caterers and sound/music providers, whom I found very reasonable and professional. I must strongly recommend Chris Caterers for their tasty, fantastic and ample spread of snacks, fruit juices and at the dinner buffet, which was greatly appreciated by all who attended the function.
Thank you very much, Racquel, Joshua and Team M. G. Banquets for a wonderful experience. Wish you all the very best.

featured_reviews.name: Aldrin D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
MG Banquets was an absolutely great place to host our wedding!
Racquel and Joshua did an amazing job of ensuring we talked through all details and did not miss out on anything.
The process was seamless, hassle free and the communications back and forth were very clear. The decorations, sound and Chris Caterers(highly recommended!) food was spot on!
More importantly, through the whole process, they were very considerate and understanding that we had many things going on.
Highly recommend this venue for weddings or any other events.
Thank you MG Banquets for an outstanding experience overall!

featured_reviews.name: Cherryl S (CS)
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fantastic experience coordinating an event at this banquet hall from overseas. The owner was incredibly receptive, making the entire planning process seamless and stress-free. Their professionalism and willingness to accommodate our needs ensured that everything went smoothly. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a well-managed and welcoming venue!

featured_reviews.review_text:
M G Banquets exceeded all expectations, offering exceptional service, stunning decor, and exquisite food. The staff was warm, attentive and ensuring our event was seamless and memorable.
The food was absolutely exquisite, that delighted every guest.
What truly set this banquet apart was their commitment to making our day memorable.
Thankyou Racquel and Joshua!!!!
If you're looking for a venue that combines sophistication, exceptional service, and a touch of magic, M G Banquets is the perfect choice. We couldn't be happier with our experience!

Keep up the Good Work MG Team

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an evening reception to celebrate our daughter's First Holy Communion. We are glad we chose MG Banquets. The hall is centrally located and quite spacious. We had around 200 people for our function and everything was arranged extremely well. The table & chairs for all 200 were set up in such a way that there was more than enough space for the dance floor..
Racquel, who handles MG Banquets was very sweet and accomodating all the time. She helped us with our other needs too, with regards to Catering, Photography etc..
We did not have any issues whatsoever with the hall and the arrangements. Racquel was always around throughout our function to make sure we do not face any problems, we anyways didnt .
The decoration too was splendid and we had a beautiful looking hall for our function.
I would surely recommend this place to people who would be seeking a nice, spacious hall for their celebrations.

featured_reviews.name: Arlene Misquitta
featured_reviews.review_text: We had our Silver Wedding reception at M.G. Banquets in December 2023. Raquel was very professional, organised, punctual and ensured that all arrangements for our function were carried out smoothly. Aki was always open to discussion and did a good job with the decor. The hall was spacious and the big dance floor was utilised to the maximum as the DJ did a phenomenal job with the music. We were happy to have had our function at M.G. Banquets and highly recommend this place for your event.

featured_reviews.name: Raj doesn't share food
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Veranda around 4 PM, and the first thing to note is that the kitchen was partially closed at that time, which limited a few options. Still, we managed to order a decent variety of dishes.
We tried prawns thecha, chicken 65, chicken tenders, pizza, pasta, and Hakka noodles. Most of the food was actually good and enjoyable. The highlight of the meal was definitely the prawns thecha, easily the best dish on the table. It was flavorful, well-cooked, and something I’d genuinely go back for.
The pizza and pasta were nice, chicken 65 was solid, and overall the food quality was pretty satisfying. But the Hakka noodles were a letdown. They had a strong smell, likely from the egg and chicken, which made it hard to enjoy the dish.
Another downside was the timing of the chicken tenders. They arrived way too late, almost after we were done eating everything else, which kind of ruined the flow of the meal.
That said, the ambience is where Veranda really stands out. The place looks amazing, has a great vibe, and the location is perfect for a chill outing in Bandra.
Overall, it’s a good place with great ambience and mostly good food, but a few issues with timing and consistency in dishes hold it back slightly.

We were explicitly assured that the afternoon event would end by 4:30 PM and that all the venues we had booked Sawai Banquet, Tiara, Ahana, and Vatika  would be fully handed over by 5:30 PM. However, when we arrived at 6:15 PM, the previous event's guests were still vacating the premises. The venue was nowhere close to being ready. Decorations had not been completed, arrangements were unfinished, and there was complete chaos instead of preparation.

The bridal room was another disappointment. The air conditioning was not working, making it extremely uncomfortable for the bride and family members during an already hectic schedule.

The washrooms were dirty, unhygienic, and clearly had not been cleaned properly despite repeated assurances regarding venue cleanliness. For a premium wedding venue, this level of neglect is simply unacceptable.

Several arrangements that were specifically promised during discussions were never provided. Direction boards for the Veg and Non-Veg food sections were missing. The Nikah setup was not arranged as committed. Guests were left confused and inconvenienced due to the lack of basic event coordination.

The situation only worsened during the reception. Even by 8:00 PM, the special reception entry that had been promised was still not ready. Chairs and sofas were covered in dust and looked as though they had not been cleaned before guests arrived. It was embarrassing to host guests under such conditions.

Parking arrangements were another complete failure. We were charged for parking facilities for approximately 30 vehicles and were informed that the venue had a tie-up with Amar Theatre to accommodate additional parking. On the wedding day, we were suddenly informed that the theatre was undergoing demolition and no parking was available. No alternative arrangements were made, leaving our guests to struggle unnecessarily.

What is most disappointing is not just the poor execution, but the complete gap between what was promised and what was delivered. The management seems far more interested in making commitments during the sales process than actually fulfilling them on the event day.

This venue excels at making promises and fails at keeping them.

Our wedding day should have been filled with joy and celebration. Instead, we spent hours dealing with delays, missing arrangements, poor cleanliness, and management failures.

I would strongly advise anyone planning a wedding or major event to avoid Sawai Banquet Hall unless they are prepared for last-minute surprises, broken commitments, and unnecessary stress.

Tall promises. Zero delivery. Zero accountability. Absolutely not recommended.
